title: Code and data for: Reporting-format change and the reliability of police at-fault flags
description:
Pipeline, derived data and result tables for the manuscript Reporting-format change and the reliability of police at-fault flags: evidence from interrupted time series and a pair-count measurement model (submitted to Accident Analysis & Prevention). The code assigns Montgomery County, Maryland, driver crash records to the legacy or the new (ACRS 2.0, 1 January 2024) reporting format, harmonises 12 coded fields, tests for label drift with interrupted time series, evaluates temporal transfer of gradient-boosted models, and estimates the sensitivity and false-flag rate of the police at-fault flag with a pair-count measurement model.

Source data: Crash Reporting - Drivers Data, Montgomery County, Maryland (dataset mmzv-x632). The data made available here has been modified for use from its original source, which is Montgomery County, Maryland. See data/README.md for the full disclaimer required by the County's Terms of Use.
